Jensen Huang, an architect of the AI boom, resigns as Nvidia CEO. Jensen Huang resigned as CEO of Nvidia after he reportedly had two affairs, including one with a purported Chinese spy. Why it matters: It's impossible to overstate how critical Huang is to Nvidia, to the AI buildout, to the stock market and economy. His departure could, per Wall Street sources, be the catalyst that endangers a ballooning AI bubble.It's also unlikely to ease congressional scrutiny of the company or Huang himself.
